items.text: NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普声称黄仁勋已辞任并应由苹果的库克接任，暗示对英伟达领导层及治理能力的负面评价。
